svg.aria-label: A village with the school, the clinic, a home and the police post around a crossroads. Fatmata, in her blue school uniform, stands in the middle of the path. Mr Koroma the teacher waves from the school door, Nurse Aminata waves from the clinic door, Haja the grandmother sits on a bench outside her home, and Officer Sesay of the Family Support Unit sits at the police post desk.
